title: Early diagnosis of nasopharyngeal carcinoma based on machine learning modelling and blood plasma metallomics analysis.
summary: Methods quantify plasma elements and train six classifiers in 168 participants; Results compare 108 NPC cases with controls and report a held-out AUC plus biomarker differences. The small study supports exploratory discrimination, not clinical diagnosis.
ai_technology: Blood-plasma metallomics and machine learning distinguish nasopharyngeal carcinoma from healthy controls with reported biomarkers. The Methods specify the learned operation used for this case-specific result.
